target_customer: Storytellers and AI filmmakers who make AI original series, and fans who fund them
problem: AI creators depend on YouTube and TikTok algorithms for distribution and have no direct way to fund and monetize original concepts. YouArt offers a video agent plus crowdfunding and subscriptions.
business_model: Credit-based AI generation subscriptions plus fan crowdfunding and creator subscriptions
product_category: AI video creation platform and creator economy

founders.name: Harry Zheng
prior_employers: TikTok (founded and grew TikTok Shop Ads)

founders.name: Edward Ma
founders.background_notes: Founding ML engineer; AI researcher with over 1,500 citations per YC page.

competitors.name: Higgsfield
competitors.what: Multi-model AI video studio for short form social creators

competitors.name: Hedra
competitors.what: Visual workspace for AI character and performance video

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrates many third-party video models, an agent workflow canvas, an MCP server and desktop apps, which is standard engineering with some hard agent work for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Model access is commodity; the fan funding and creator audience layer could create a two sided marketplace but it is early.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-funded AI video tools already bundle models; no takeover found yet.

market_need_then: YC page claims revenue growth from $0 to over $120K monthly in five months (company reported, unverified). Creators of AI shorts lack direct monetization outside platform ad algorithms.

branding.domain_note: Uses youart.ai; legal entity named Formative Intelligence Inc.

identity.logo: YouArt wordmark in light and dark versions
identity.voice_and_tone: Practical and creator focused; stresses the creator's point of view over replacing creative judgment

branding.brand_signature: Patreon for AI Originals positioning line
branding.community_and_virality: No community or press about the brand found beyond directories and the YC launch post.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name that is confusable with other art and AI sites; the Patreon for AI Originals tagline is the memorable asset.

outcome_analysis: YouArt entered YC in Spring 2026 with a company reported $120K monthly revenue after five months, driven by a multi-model AI video studio. No outcome yet. The bet is that a fan funding and subscription layer differentiates it from model aggregators like Higgsfield, but model access is easy to copy and bigger players move fast.
notes: Aggregators (CB Insights, FundedIQ, VCBacked) list about $500K pre-seed or convertible note with Y Combinator as investor, with round dates conflicting (January and June 2026). This matches YC's standard deal and is unverified, so it is not recorded as a round. One aggregator names a third founder (Keith Zhang) not on the YC page, so not listed. Competitor sources are undated vendor listicles. Outcome search found no news of shutdown or acquisition.
